summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (read-only audit complete — no code changed)  ### What I found I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts`. The watchlist backend itself is correctly scoped — every GET/POST/PUT/DELETE handler filters by `watchlists.user_id` derived from the session, there's no anonymous/localStorage fallback on the client, and cookies are sent with `credentials: "include"` on every request. So the ticket's own hypothesis ("client wiring bug") doesn't hold up — I didn't find a wiring defect in the watchlist path.  What
